name: Cardiac Risk
description: Estimates the likelihood of coronary heart disease from 13 routine clinical measurements (UCI Cleveland dataset).

features.label: Age
features.help: Heart disease risk rises steadily with age.

features.label: Sex
features.q: What is the patient's biological sex?
features.help: Men tend to develop coronary disease earlier than women.

features.label: Chest pain type
features.q: Which best describes the patient's chest pain?
features.help: Typical angina is pressure-like pain on exertion that eases with rest. Notably, in this dataset many patients with disease reported no chest pain at all.

features.label: Resting blood pressure
features.help: The top number of a blood-pressure reading taken at rest.

features.label: Cholesterol
features.help: Total blood cholesterol. Under 200 mg/dl is considered desirable.

features.label: Fasting blood sugar
features.q: Is fasting blood sugar above 120 mg/dl?
features.help: High fasting glucose is a sign of diabetes, a major heart-disease risk factor.

features.label: Resting ECG
features.q: What did the resting ECG show?
features.help: An electrocardiogram records the heart's electrical activity.

opts.d: ST-T wave abnormality on resting ECG
Left ventricular hypertrophy on resting ECG

features.label: Max heart rate
features.q: Maximum heart rate reached during the exercise test (bpm)?
features.help: A lower peak heart rate on a stress test can signal a heart that struggles under load.

features.label: Exercise-induced angina
features.q: Did exercise bring on chest pain?
features.help: Chest pain during the stress test suggests reduced blood flow to the heart.

features.label: ST depression
features.help: How far the ST segment of the ECG drops during exercise. Over 1 mm suggests ischemia.

features.label: ST slope
features.q: Slope of the ST segment at peak exercise?
features.help: Upsloping is the normal response. Flat or downsloping is more concerning.

features.label: Blocked major vessels
features.q: How many major vessels showed narrowing on fluoroscopy (0-3)?
features.help: The number of the main coronary arteries with visible narrowing.

features.label: Thallium stress test
features.q: Result of the thallium stress scan?
features.help: A nuclear scan showing blood flow to the heart muscle at rest and under stress.

opts.d: Normal blood flow on thallium scan

what_if.text: fasting blood sugar brought under 120 mg/dl

recommendations.text: Symptoms or stress-test findings suggest ischemia: a cardiology referral for further testing is advisable.
Imaging shows vessel narrowing or perfusion defects: discuss coronary assessment with a cardiologist.
Blood pressure is above 140 mmHg: blood-pressure management is recommended.
Cholesterol is above 240 mg/dl: a lipid review is recommended.
Fasting blood sugar is elevated: screening for diabetes is recommended.
Low estimated risk: keep up regular check-ups and a heart-healthy lifestyle.
